collection.description: Two teenagers want to hang a hammock in the best shady spot, where an elder already rests each afternoon.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (teen1) and (teen2), two teenagers, want to hang a hammock in the best shady spot, where (elder) already rests each afternoon.

choices.label: Build a Second Safe Resting Place
Ask the Elder About the Spot

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (elder) agrees to mornings and the teens take afternoons.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The teens discover (elder) needs the shade for a health reason and choose another spot.

text_only.reason: health or an injury in the story (the event's premise or a word in passing); nobody's health changes -- the volume's outcomes are story text unless an effect is marked

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: With adult help, they select sturdy supports without damaging a young tree.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Their first location is unsuitable, and the teens accept the safety advice without giving up.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (elder) tells a funny story about claiming the shade decades ago.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (elder) invites them to sit and discuss why the place matters to each of them.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The teens turn a nearby clearing into their own quiet retreat.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: They realize they wanted privacy more than the hammock itself and make a different plan.
